description:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable
